name: Remote Screen
description: Remote screens in the browser, three protocols behind one viewer: VNC (noVNC over a raw WebSocket->TCP byte bridge), RDP (same bridge, pending a browser-side client), and Android (live ~2 fps screen mirror + tap/swipe/text/key input over the remote-agent exec channel — no VNC server involved). Hosts live in this app's own Postgres table with per-app SQL migrations; passwords in the workspace secret store. Ports the monolith's src/api/routes/remote_desktop.py + android_viewer.py + RemoteDesktopWindow.jsx.

default_scaling.description: How the noVNC viewport fits the window: scale (fit locally), remote (ask the server to resize its desktop), none (1:1 with scrollbars).

view_only.description: Open every session read-only — the remote desktop is rendered but keyboard/mouse input is not forwarded.

connect_timeout_s.description: Seconds to wait for the TCP connection to a host before the bridge gives up and closes the WebSocket with code 4502.
